name: Minor Healing Pill
flavor: Lu pounds a viper-fang to chalk in ten seconds flat, mutters at a ribbon of eel-skin, and rolls two neat brown pills between his thumb and palm. He sniffs one. 'Good enough for a disciple. Better than good enough for you.'

name: Spirit Gathering Pill
flavor: One seed, split. Lu grinds each half with a different pestle — 'the left one is friendlier' — and rolls two pine-green pills. They smell of forest rain.

name: Iron Skin Pill
flavor: The carapace-plates go into the mortar first, fang last, so the fang 'bites something on the way down.' Lu scowls at his own joke and presses a black-metal pill. 'Do not chew it. One has been chewed before. The disciple who chewed it is fine, but his teeth are not.'

name: Thundergold Pill
flavor: Lu holds the spirit stone up to the sun; it casts a shadow like weather. 'If you feel the pill laughing in your meridians — sit down. It will pass.' The storm-feather he chars, the lotus-seed he spares, and the result is a pill veined with hair-thin silver.
